search_window.basis: Since most recent independently read-back verified Food Line Source Watch heartbeat at 17:45:35 PST; 2-day recency search used to allow indexing lag, but qualification requires new or newly substantiated immediate food-access harm since that heartbeat.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall of high-value food-access disruptions only; production nationwide collection remains authoritative.
target_classes: Loss of only/sole/last/full-service community grocery by closure, fire or disaster
Emergency food distribution canceled/suspended due to storm, flood, fire, outage or facility damage
Abrupt food pantry or food bank closure or major access reduction
Official new SNAP, WIC or other food-assistance interruption with immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: "only grocery store" closure fire November 2 2026 local community
"sole grocery store" fire destroyed November 2026 town
"full-service grocery" closure fire November 2 2026 small town
"food pantry" closed flood power outage November 2 2026
coverage_notes.observation: All 12 targeted searches returned usable coverage, but no independently verifiable newly reported qualifying U.S. food-access disruption in the window. Matches were mostly older sole-store losses, historical disaster/pantry incidents, routine access resources and unrelated or dated benefits notices. A fresh search crawl alone did not establish a new event.

excluded_examples.reason: Eastport, Maine only grocery closure is a historical September report, not new this hour.
Spencer, New York only grocery fire reported in September.
Earlier resource/recovery guide, no newly verified suspended emergency distribution.
Historical fire report from Canada, outside U.S. remit.

duplicate_screen.method: Inspected branch directory and previous heartbeat; compared search matches by event date, source date, U.S. geography, and already known cases.

coverage_notes.limitations: This bounded recall is not exhaustive; very recent local/provider notices may not yet be indexed. No confirmed positive signal in targeted search coverage.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No editorial approval, publication, primary pipeline mutation, schedule change, or disabling.
